_comment: This is used within about two weeks of the conference start date. It is comprised of information collected via a survey that Kay or Kevin sets up for authors.

attendance._comment: Occasionally conferences will want to display if the speaker is an online speaker; otherwise it's just internal info and is not displayed on the program.

eprint._comment: This is really only used if publisher is running behind. It is NOT used for paper URLs from Springer/ToSC/TCHES; those go in the program.json as paperUrl and are typically the DOI link.
